# name: Xquic comes to the grandmother and the net of maize
# title: Arecut e ꜭo ri vchuch
# fols: fols. 17r–18r
Arecut e ꜭo ri vchuch Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, ta xul ri ixoc Xquic vbi. Ta xul cut ri ixoc Xquic ruꜭ ri vchuch Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen; xꜭol oc ral chupam, xa zcaquin chic maui que yaqueic ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque qui bi.

Ta xul curi ixoc chire ri atit; xꜭha curi ixoc chire ri atit: “Mi xin vlic, lal chichu; in alib la, in puch alcual la, lal chichu,” xꜭha, ta xoc vloc ruꜭ ri atit.

“Apa cat pe vi vloc? Ꜭo chi pa ri val? Ma pa xe camic chi Xibalba? E cu caib canoc quetal, qui ꜩihel puch, Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen qui bi; ve a vila? Cat pe vi, cat el vbic!” xuꜭhax ri capoh rumal atit.

“Xere la, quiꜩih vi chi in alib la; xꜭo nare. In ꜭo vi rech Hunhunahpu. Va vcaam e ꜭazlic; maui e caminac ri Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu; xa vcatbal rib zac mi xqui bano. Lal valib. Quehe cut i vila ta chi loc vvach ri vcaam,” xuꜭhaxic ri atit.

Arecut que cacal ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen: xa zu, xa bix ca qui bano, xa zibanic, xa pu cotonic qui chaquih chi hutaquih; arecut cubul vi vꜭux ri atit.

Xꜭha chicut atit: “Xma ca uah vi at ta valib; xa a hoxbal ri ꜭo cha pam; at ꜭaxtoꜭ. Xe cam vi val ca biyh.”

Xꜭha chicut ri atit: “Quiꜩih ibare va ca nu biyh. Vꜩ bala, at valib ca nu tao. Vhat bala, ha cama quecha vi chi qui veeh; ha hacha hun chi nima cat; chi petic, at na cu valib ca nu tao,” xuꜭhax cut ri capoh.

“Vꜩ bala,” xꜭha cut. Catepuch ta xbec pa abix ꜭo vi cabix ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, hocam vbeel cumal. Xu taqueh cut capoh, xopon puch chi ri pa abix.

Xa cu huvi ri abix; xma ꜭo chivi vcavi, roxvi; xu vachelaam vi vvach chi huvi. Ta xquiz cut vꜭux ri capoh: “Quila in macol, in ꜭazbol! Apa xchin cam vi ri hun cat echa ca bixic?” xcha cut.

Catepuch vziquixic Chahal Echa rumal: “Ta hul val oc, ta hul tacal oc. Xtoh, Xcanil, Xcacau, ix pu ꜩiya; at Chahal re queꜭha Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen!” xꜭha ri capoh.

Ta xu cam cut ri zamiy, vzamiyal vvi hal; xu boc acan oc; maui xu hach ri hal; chi cau cut ri hal echa pa cat; xcaxinic ri nima cat.

Ta xpe cut ri capoh. Xa cu chicop xecan ri cat. Ta xpetic, xbe qui ya vcoc xucut ha, quehe ri recan. Xoponic, xril ri atit. Catepuch ta xril ri atit ri echa hun chi nima cat:

“Apa mi xpe vi ri echa auumal? Mi xe a calaba vi, ve mi xquiz a cam vloc ri cabix? Chi be na vila,” xꜭha ri atit. Ta xbe puch, xbe rila ri abix.

Xavi xere ꜭo vi ri huvi abix; xavi cu xere calah vcolibal cat chuxe. Anim chicut xpe ri atit, xul chicut chi rochoch; xꜭha chicut chire ri capoh: “Xere vi retal ri quiꜩih vi chi at valib. Chi vil chi na a banoh, ri e ꜭo ri vi e nauinac chic,” xuꜭhax cut capoh.
